CMOS autozero inverter comparator
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VAZ az 0 PULSE(3.3 0 50n 100p 100p 299.9n 400n)
VIN vin 0 PWL(0 .8 80n .8 90n .9 170n .9 180n .7 280n .7 290n .8 350n .8 360n 1.6 480n 1.6 490n 1.7 570n 1.7 580n 1.5 680n 1.5 690n 1.6 750n 1.6 760n 2.4 880n 2.4 890n 2.5 970n 2.5 980n 2.3 1100n 2.3)
XDUT vdd 0 vin x az out astra_074_cmos_autozero_inverter_comparator
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec pos0 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec neg0 range -0.02 0.02 unit=V
* @spec zero0 range 1.2 1.3 unit=V
* @spec pos1 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec neg1 range -0.02 0.02 unit=V
* @spec zero1 range 1.2 1.3 unit=V
* @spec pos2 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec neg2 range -0.02 0.02 unit=V
* @spec zero2 range 1.2 1.3 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 100p 1100n
meas tran pos0 FIND v(out) AT=140n
meas tran neg0 FIND v(out) AT=240n
meas tran zero0 FIND v(x) AT=40n
meas tran pos1 FIND v(out) AT=540n
meas tran neg1 FIND v(out) AT=640n
meas tran zero1 FIND v(x) AT=440n
meas tran pos2 FIND v(out) AT=940n
meas tran neg2 FIND v(out) AT=1040n
meas tran zero2 FIND v(x) AT=840n
write out.raw v(out) v(x) v(vin) v(az)
quit
.endc
.end
